title: Intermittent task_not_found under 8 concurrent edits of one existing task (opum-cli-e2e T-1 row, linux-arm64, 0.15.1)
description: opum-cli-e2e row quest/fault :: 8 concurrent edits to the same record (T-1) failed once on opum-ai/opum-cli-e2e run 45007531871 attempt 1 (job 137162532431, head 2986991c, self-hosted linux-arm64, registry @opum-ai/quest@0.15.1): 4 ok, 3 conflict, 1 other = exit 3 task_not_found. Passed on re-run. Expected outcomes are success or exit 5. DIAGNOSIS ONLY so far; no fix. Local reproduction against registry 0.15.1 found zero: macOS arm64 500 iterations x 8 on one task (4000 edits) and 300 fresh workspaces mirroring the e2e row (12 concurrent creates, list, doctor, 8 edits on the first listed id; 2400 edits), plus linux aarch64 node:22-bookworm container on overlayfs, 200 workspaces (1600 edits): 0 task_not_found, 0 other in all 8000 edits. Not reproduced, so the cause is unproven. Read of the edit path: the single-record write is temp file + rename over the destination (src/application/tasks/local-task-repository.ts:652-682, writeActiveRecord :81-85), identical between v0.14.1 and v0.15.1 (empty git diff for that file), so a rename-over window for the destination name is not what POSIX rename allows. Hypotheses, UNMEASURED: (H1) readers enumerate with readdir then readFile (recordsAt :286-306), the snapshot is read UNLOCKED before the write (TaskService.edit/editOn tasks.ts:1253-1299), and readdir ordering under a concurrent create+rename-over of the same name is unspecified, so a snapshot can omit an existing record and findTask throws task_not_found; (H2) recordsAt turns ANY ENOENT in readdir or readFile into an empty list for the whole directory (:302-304), so one listed .json vanishing between readdir and readFile would make every record absent; no edit-path code removes a .json, so this needs another actor.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The cause of the e2e T-1 task_not_found is identified by a reproduction or a stated measurement, or the finding is recorded as not reproducible with the loop and platforms tried
If a defect is confirmed in quest, an edit of an existing task under concurrent edits can only return success or a write conflict, and a test fails without the fix
